title: At Hunter's Camp, the menu offered 'read the tally marks by the smoke rack (DC 9, wits)' as a distinct action; after asking the hunter about 'the old barrow' (whose reply referenced 'it's in the tally by the rack'), that option silently disappeared from the menu on the next screen without me ever selecting it or seeing any text saying it had been read.
